purpose: Test whether S2's Stage-1 quality gain (stage1_history_intervention_s2) survives the complete two-stage RECE pipeline -- Stage-2 refinement with historical preservation applied to the already-improved S2_STAGE1_HISTORY checkpoint -- while maintaining historical (English springer) erasure and golf-ball deletion, and without new retained-class loss. English springer is the historical ERASED concept; its continued absence is desired, not a failure. Existing-method control using the already-validated fp64 stable-solve implementation; not a new method, not a claim about unmodified upstream RECE.

working_unet_start.note: the Stage-1-with-historical-preservation checkpoint this refinement is applied to

recovery_step.reference: separate pristine M0 -- never the working model, never EnglishSpringer_parent
recovery_step.method: vf.close_form_emb_regzero, regular_scale=0.1, with_to_k=True, seed=42, native fp32, full 77-token
recovery_step.guide_and_retain: NOT re-encoded -- reused from existing files (hashes above), guide=' ', retain=['English springer']
recovery_step.note: the old E_S2_newtarget (recovered from the corrupted S2_Stage1 checkpoint) is explicitly NOT reused -- a fresh recovery from this improved working UNet is required

refinement_step.precision: fp64 assembly and Cholesky solve, fp32 storage/inference
refinement_step.objective: J(V) = lambda*||V-W||_F^2 + erase*||V X^T - W G^T||_F^2 + preserve*||V R^T - W R^T||_F^2
refinement_step.normal_equations: H = lambda*I + erase*(X^T X) + preserve*(R^T R); N = lambda*W + erase*(W G^T X) + preserve*(W R^T R); solve H V^T = N^T
refinement_step.per_layer_W: the untouched S2_STAGE1_HISTORY weight for that layer (not S2_Stage1, not M0)
refinement_step.X: the newly recovered embedding[0] from the recovery step above
refinement_step.guide_and_preserve_targets_source: this improved pre-refinement W (S2_STAGE1_HISTORY) -- never M0, never the earlier parent

execution_order: 1. Verify all input hashes, pinned-source checks.
2. GPU: recover 'golf ball' embedding once from the S2_STAGE1_HISTORY working UNet vs. pristine M0 reference; verify storage separation and value invariance.
3. CPU-only fp64: assemble H/N per layer, solve, verify backward error <=1e-10 and quadratic-gap identity <=1e-8*max(1,|J(W)|,|J(V*)|) using W as diagnostic candidate.

4. Save checkpoint; independently clone the intended final CPU state BEFORE saving; after reload, assert exact key/shape/dtype/value equality to that clone, changed-key set equals the 32-key whitelist exactly, all 686 tensors finite.
5. Generate 80 images on the reused manifest; release GPU.
6. Individually review all 80 images (including retained classes) at native 512x512.
7. Freeze and hash labels before classification.

8. Run the classification guard: a single executed wrapper that validates the 80-case ID set, image hashes, completion rows, and label hashes, logs the check, and only then invokes classification in the same guarded path. Refuse on failure.
9. Compute joint outcomes against S2_STAGE1_HISTORY (primary comparator), with parent/blank/existing-final as context.
scoped_stop_rule: on a consequential provenance/hash mismatch or a failed build check, stop before generation and publish a scoped failure; no silent repair, no relaxed tolerance, no artifact substitution
forbidden: a second arm (e.g. refinement-blank from the same improved input)
claims of universal generalization or novelty
